$comment: Role UI profile (demo-specific presentation). Per-role display text and form behaviour for the reference implementation, keyed by role id from roles.json: the English label/description, and which ESPD Parts the UI shows (visibleParts) and lets the user edit (editableParts). The authoritative, implementer-neutral role facts (ids, documentType, exclusion dispositions, UBL role mapping) are in roles.json; model/compiler/roles.mjs joins the two and emits model/generated/ui/roles.json plus the English catalogue.
$note: Part V (reduction of the number of qualified candidates) is intentionally NOT shown to buyers: it has no buyer requirement to express and nothing to edit; the economic operator answers it. So it is omitted from the buyer roles' visibleParts/editableParts.

contracting-authority.label: Contracting Authority
contracting-authority.description: A contracting authority subject to Directive 2014/24/EU creating an ESPD Request.

contracting-entity.label: Contracting Entity
contracting-entity.description: A contracting entity subject to Directive 2014/25/EU (utilities: water, energy, transport, postal services) creating an ESPD Request.

sole-tenderer.label: Sole tenderer
sole-tenderer.description: Economic operator which has submitted a tender without being part of a group of economic operators.

group-lead.label: Group leader
group-lead.description: Economic operator which is the leader of a group of economic operators.

group-mem.label: Group member
group-mem.description: Economic operator, which is a member of a group of economic operators, without being the leader.

oeron.label: Other entity (relied upon)
oeron.description: Economic operator (who is not a subcontractor) on which the tenderer relies upon, to meet selection criteria.

subcont.label: Subcontractor
subcont.description: Economic operator to whom the contractor assigns a share of the contract.
